Jules Park: Heads-up from today's usability pass — found a few small but important inconsistencies between the in-console help panel and docs site that we should fix before the next patch.

Renee Soto: Thanks Jules. High-level examples?

Jules Park: 1) Console labels the feature as 'Model routes' while docs use 'Model endpoints'. 2) The help panel CTA opens `/help/model-routes` but canonical docs are at `/docs/model-endpoints`. 3) The help panel hint uses a 14px subhead; Console standard is 18px.

Devon Marsh: On the lexicon, I vote docs canonicalize to 'Model endpoints' (more common) and Console shows 'Model routes (endpoints)' for one release. That eases search.

Carlos Vega: Dev note: the help panel's internal router supports aliases but the redirect table is maintained in two places. We should add a route alias `/help/model-routes` -> `/docs/model-endpoints` in docs redirects config.

Renee Soto: Also accessibility/contrast note: the sidecar link color for visited links is #6c6c6c which fails contrast on the grey bg. Can we use the Console visited-link token (#005ea6) or add underline?

Accessibility Bot: a11y-scan: visited-link color #6c6c6c on bg #f6f7f8 — contrast ratio 2.8:1 (WCAG AA target 4.5:1). Recommend change.

Devon Marsh: Agree — update token to `--link-visited` to Console token. I'll put a quick PR to change the sidecar CSS variable.

Carlos Vega: Also a runtime UX thing: when streaming responses come in from the docs examples, we don't surface an aria-live announcement in the sidecar; screen-reader users don't know new tokens arrived. Need `aria-live="polite"` on the stream container.

Renee Soto: Good catch. Also keyboard shortcut: users expect `?` to open help but the sidecar doesn't bind it when focus is in an embedded iframe (docs preview). Can we ensure the global keybinding still triggers?

Devon Marsh: We already have a global shortcut handler, but the iframe blocks key events. I'll add a small postMessage bridge so embedded previews forward `?` events.

Jules Park: Action list: Devon 1 - PR to standardize sidecar link color token + postMessage for `?`; Carlos 1 - add route alias in redirects config; Renee 1 - update mock with 18px subhead and the transitional label copy; I'll write the release note blurb.

Accessibility Bot: Created task #4891: "Fix visited-link contrast in help sidecar; add aria-live to streaming example; ensure keyboard shortcut forwarding."

Jules Park: Thanks team 1 small wins but will cut confusion and reduce support contacts. Tracking in #product. :white_check_mark:
